title: รัฐบาลโต้ข้อเสนอยุบศูนย์ CI แรงงานเมียนมา ชี้ไทยคัดค้านปมบังคับส่งเงินกลับ 25%

summary_cn: 泰国政府否决关闭缅甸劳工 CI（个人检查中心）的提议，质问批评方提出替代方案。政府强调个人背景调查与国籍认证属不同权限，重申反对强制要求缅甸劳工将收入 25% 汇回本国的政策条款，维护劳工权益。

title: NSC meets to assess readiness
desc: The National Security Council (NSC) will meet today to discuss potential security threats stemming from instability in the Middle East and cyberattacks, as the government steps up preparations for possible disruptions to energy supplies and supply chains.
title_cn: 国家安全委员会召开会议评估应急准备
summary_cn: 泰国国家安全委员会（NSC）今日召开会议，讨论中东局势不稳定和网络攻击可能对国家安全造成的威胁。政府正加紧准备应对能源供应中断和供应链受阻等可能风险，以维护国计民生。
desc_original: The National Security Council (NSC) will meet today to discuss potential security threats stemming from instability in the Middle East and cyberattacks, as the government steps up preparations for possible disruptions to energy supplies and supply chains.

desc: บีโอไอหนุนปรับภาษีสรรพสามิตรถยนต์ไฟฟ้านำเข้าเป็น 35% หวังกระตุ้นค่ายรถเพิ่มการผลิตในไทย พร้อมเร่งใช้ชิ้นส่วนในประเทศ สร้างงานและยกระดับอุตสาหกรรมยานยนต์ไทย

summary_cn: 泰国投资委员会（BOI）宣布支持将进口电动车特许税从当前水平提至35%。此举旨在激励汽车制造商增加泰国本地生产能力，扩大国内零部件使用，创造更多就业机会，提升泰国汽车工业竞争力。

title: เปิดราคาตั๋วเครื่องบินปีใหม่ “กรุงเทพฯ–ภูเก็ต” แพงสุด แนะจองล่วงหน้า
desc: เผยผลสำรวจค่าตั๋วเครื่องบิน 8 เส้นทางบินสุดฮิตช่วงปีใหม่ พบค่าตั๋วโดยสาร กรุงเทพฯ–ภูเก็ต แพงสุด รองลงมาคือเส้นทางกรุงเทพฯ–เชียงใหม่ แนะผู้โดยสารจองล่วงหน้าและเปรียบเทียบราคาก่อนเดินทาง
title_cn: 新年出行指南：曼谷—普吉航线票价最贵 提前订购更优惠
summary_cn: 调查显示泰国新年期间8条热门航线的机票价格，其中曼谷（Bangkok）至普吉（Phuket）航线票价最高，曼谷至清迈（Chiang Mai）居次。旅客建议提前订票并货比三家以获得更优惠价格。
desc_original: เผยผลสำรวจค่าตั๋วเครื่องบิน 8 เส้นทางบินสุดฮิตช่วงปีใหม่ พบค่าตั๋วโดยสาร กรุงเทพฯ–ภูเก็ต แพงสุด รองลงมาคือเส้นทางกรุงเทพฯ–เชียงใหม่ แนะผู้โดยสารจองล่วงหน้าและเปรียบเทียบราคาก่อนเดินทาง

title: Thailand Post offers tool to manage EU export rules
desc: Thailand Post now allows online merchants and small and medium-sized enterprises to send goods to the European Union's (EU) 27 member states by filling in the mandatory product identifier (PID) code on its DPost Inter website, in compliance with EU customs requirements.
title_cn: 泰国邮政推出欧盟出口规则管理工具
summary_cn: 泰国邮政推出新工具，允许在线商户和中小企业通过 DPost Inter 网站填写强制产品识别码 (PID)，向欧盟 27 个成员国寄送商品，并符合欧盟海关要求。
desc_original: Thailand Post now allows online merchants and small and medium-sized enterprises to send goods to the European Union's (EU) 27 member states by filling in the mandatory product identifier (PID) code on its DPost Inter website, in compliance with EU customs requirements.

title: Phuket emerges as year-round draw
desc: Phuket's property market continues to expand despite a slowdown in Thailand's housing sector, supported by infrastructure investment, new commercial developments and a growing population relocating to the island.
title_cn: 普吉岛成为全年热门投资地
summary_cn: 普吉岛房产市场持续扩张，尽管泰国整体住房市场放缓，但得益于基础设施投资、新商业开发和不断增加的人口流入，房产市场保持增长动力。
desc_original: Phuket's property market continues to expand despite a slowdown in Thailand's housing sector, supported by infrastructure investment, new commercial developments and a growing population relocating to the island.

title: Ikea promotes small-store concept
desc: Ikea Thailand expects its small-store concept to help the brand expand into untapped areas, paving the way for further growth.
title_cn: 宜家推广小店概念
summary_cn: 宜家泰国分部希望通过小店概念进入未开发市场，为品牌进一步拓展铺路。
desc_original: Ikea Thailand expects its small-store concept to help the brand expand into untapped areas, paving the way for further growth.

title: Regulator spurns US telecom proposals
desc: The board of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) has repeatedly rejected pressure from the US, funnelled through the Commerce Ministry, for Thailand to fully open the domestic telecom sector to 100% foreign ownership, as well as adopt US standards for the use of the upper 6 gigahertz spectrum band for WiFi.
title_cn: 泰国通信委员会拒绝美国电信提议
summary_cn: 泰国国家广播和电信委员会 (NBTC) 再次拒绝美国通过商务部施压的要求，包括允许泰国电信部门 100% 外资所有权，以及采用美国 6 吉赫兹频谱 WiFi 标准。
desc_original: The board of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) has repeatedly rejected pressure from the US, funnelled through the Commerce Ministry, for Thailand to fully open the domestic telecom sector to 100% foreign ownership, as well as adopt US standards for the use of the upper 6 gigahertz spectrum band for WiFi.

title: K-Asset: Longer lives reshape retirement strategies for Thais
desc: Longer lifespans are complicating retirement planning amid market uncertainty, inflation and rising healthcare costs, prompting Kasikorn Asset Management (K-Asset) to recommend investors shift their focus from wealth accumulation to income generation in retirement.
title_cn: 人均寿命延长重塑泰国退休投资策略
summary_cn: 人均寿命延长加剧退休规划难度，加之市场不确定性、通胀和医疗成本上升，开泰资产管理公司 (K-Asset) 建议投资者将重点从财富积累转向退休收入生成。
desc_original: Longer lifespans are complicating retirement planning amid market uncertainty, inflation and rising healthcare costs, prompting Kasikorn Asset Management (K-Asset) to recommend investors shift their focus from wealth accumulation to income generation in retirement.

title: Chamber sounds alarm on food raw material issues
desc: To strengthen Thailand's position as the "Kitchen of the World", the government must address the raw material shortage, says the head of the Thai Chamber of Commerce.
title_cn: 商会敲警钟：食品原料供应短缺
summary_cn: 泰国工商总会主席指出，为维持泰国「世界厨房」的地位，政府必须解决食品原料短缺问题。原料短缺制约了泰国农业和食品产业的核心竞争力，亟需政府采取措施。
desc_original: To strengthen Thailand's position as the "Kitchen of the World", the government must address the raw material shortage, says the head of the Thai Chamber of Commerce.

title: Offering security in fraught times
desc: Global uncertainty from geopolitical tensions, rising energy costs and potential disruptions to critical infrastructure could create opportunities for Thailand's agriculture and food industries as countries seek to strengthen food security and build up emergency reserves.
title_cn: 危局中的安全机遇
summary_cn: 全球地缘政治紧张、能源成本上升及基础设施风险促使各国加强粮食安全防范。这为泰国农业和食品产业创造商机，各国正积极建立应急储备，泰国有望抢占市场份额。
desc_original: Global uncertainty from geopolitical tensions, rising energy costs and potential disruptions to critical infrastructure could create opportunities for Thailand's agriculture and food industries as countries seek to strengthen food security and build up emergency reserves.

title: Police brace for protest convoy in capital
desc: Police are preparing for a protest convoy of up to 1,000 vehicles heading to Bangkok to demand a 10-baht cut in fuel prices and measures to ease the cost of living.
title_cn: 曼谷警方备战大规模抗议车队
summary_cn: 警察部门为迎接最多1000辆车的抗议车队做准备。抗议者将前往曼谷要求政府下调燃料价格10泰铢，并采取措施缓解生活成本压力，引发公共安全和交通关注。
desc_original: Police are preparing for a protest convoy of up to 1,000 vehicles heading to Bangkok to demand a 10-baht cut in fuel prices and measures to ease the cost of living.

title: Energy cost crisis mounts
desc: Tax cuts on two selected fuels have failed to address the energy-cost crisis, as protests loom and pressure mounts on the government.
title_cn: 能源成本危机持续升温
summary_cn: 政府对两类燃料的税收减免政策未能有效缓解能源成本危机。随着大规模抗议活动迫在眉睫，政府面临越来越大的压力，寻求解决方案以稳定物价和民心。
desc_original: Tax cuts on two selected fuels have failed to address the energy-cost crisis, as protests loom and pressure mounts on the government.

title: TAT earmarks budget for year-end foreign markets
desc: As the conflict in the Middle East continues, the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) is planning to allocate part of its emergency budget to stimulate foreign markets during the final two months of the year.
title_cn: 泰国旅游局年底海外促销预算启动

title: Phuket landfill closes indefinitely amid waste crisis
desc: Phuket landfill closes indefinitely amid waste crisis Legacy Phuket City Municipality suspended rubbish deliveries to its landfill today, November 8, after mounting waste overwhelmed the site and several trucks dumped rubbish on an access road , blocking other vehicles. The suspension will remain in place indefinitely while officials prepare additional landfill space and coordinate with local councils and waste collection contractors. Phuket City Mayor Supachoke Laongphet signed the announcement today, describing the situation at the municipality’s waste disposal centre as its seventh waste management crisis . Photo via Phuket Municipality According to the municipality, the volume of rubbish arriving at the landfill has exceeded its capacity, forcing officials to arrange additional machinery to prepare new areas for waste disposal. The work has caused significant delays over the past week, with rubbish trucks having to wait longer than usual to enter the landfill. The situation worsened this morning when several rubbish truck drivers reportedly refused to wait and instead dumped their loads on the road leading into the disposal area. Photo via Phuket Municipality The discarde

desc: South Korean tourists targeted in Chiang Mai supplement scam Legacy Police raided two businesses in Chiang Mai today, November 8, following complaints from South Korean tourists who said they were taken by tour operators to buy unregistered health supplements costing up to 40,000 baht per box. The tourists reported that the products were advertised as treatments for various illnesses by a man posing as a traditional medicine expert. They discovered after returning to South Korea that the supplements lacked Thai Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval. The complaints prompted an investigation involving tourist police, the Department of Tourism and Chiang Mai provincial public health officials, who obtained search warrants from Chiang Mai Provincial Court for two locations. Photo via Facebook: Thaipolice The first raid targeted a company in Ton Pao subdistrict, San Kamphaeng district, where officers found four types of health supplements. Two were classified as regulated medicines or food products without the required FDA approval and were seized for examination. title: Southern Thailand rail expansion gets 106.8 billion baht backing
desc: Southern Thailand rail expansion gets 106.8 billion baht backing Legacy Thailand is pressing ahead with major transport projects across the South , including a 106.8 billion baht double-track railway expansion and two new bridges in Songkhla and Krabi. Deputy Transport Minister Sanphet Boonyamanee confirmed the plans yesterday, November 7, saying the government remains committed to improving southern Thailand’s roads, railways and transport links while addressing obstacles holding up development. The investments, overseen by Deputy Prime Minister and Transport Minister Phiphat Ratchakitprakarn, are intended to improve connectivity, reduce transport costs and support economic growth across the region. Sanphet acknowledged that large infrastructure projects can take years to complete. He said the ministry would continue addressing obstacles and speeding up projects that are ready to proceed. One of the largest developments is the second phase of the southern double-track railway project, which will extend the network further into southern Thailand. title: Four arrested over alleged 20-million-baht Freedom Beach land fraud in Phuket
desc: Four arrested over alleged 20-million-baht Freedom Beach land fraud in Phuket Legacy Police have arrested a Phuket man known as Sia Lek and three family members over the alleged sale of protected forest land behind Freedom Beach , where buyers lost more than 20 million baht. All four denied the charges, and forestry officers planned to start demolishing structures at the beach this morning, November 8. Officers from the Central Investigation Bureau’s Crime Suppression Division arrested the four outside a house in Kathu district at about 8.15am yesterday, November 7. Sia Lek, whose full name is Parinthon Rueangrattanawanich, faces charges of jointly defrauding the public and entering false data into a computer system, while his wife, his daughter and his son-in-law each face the fraud charge. Police allege the group took over land in the Khao Nak Kerd National Forest Reserve and sold it to Thai and foreign buyers as land with title documents, and that the possession document Sia Lek relied on refers to a different location. title: Thailand plans tougher driving licence rules for foreigners
desc: Thailand plans tougher driving licence rules for foreigners Legacy Thailand is considering major changes to driving licence requirements for foreigners , including scrapping exemptions from driving tests and requiring applicants to have at least two years of visa validity remaining. The Department of Land Transport (DLT) published the proposed changes on November 4, opening a public consultation that will run until December 4. The draft would amend regulations introduced in 2022 governing driving licence training and testing, with three proposed changes specifically targeting foreign applicants. Under the current rules, foreigners holding a valid driving licence from their home country or an International Driving Permit (IDP) can obtain a Thai driving licence without completing the standard training course, written examination or practical driving test. The DLT wants to remove these exemptions for both temporary two-year licences and five-year licences, meaning foreign applicants would have to complete the required training and tests even if they already hold a valid foreign licence. Another proposed change would require foreigners applying for a temporary two-year Thai driving lic

title: Koh Lanta bridge in Krabi set to start construction on November 14
desc: Koh Lanta bridge in Krabi set to start construction on November 14 Legacy Construction of a 1.78-billion-baht bridge linking Koh Lanta in Krabi with the mainland is due to start on Saturday, November 14, when the Department of Rural Roads plans to issue the order for work to begin. Construction of the 2.24-kilometre Koh Lanta bridge should take about three years, and the bridge is due to open in 2029, reducing the island’s reliance on the vehicle ferry. Deputy Transport Minister Sanpetch Boonyamanee, who oversees the ministry’s work in the South, gave the start date while setting out the ministry’s investment plans for the region, adding that a larger bridge over Songkhla Lake will follow the same schedule. The department signed construction contracts for both bridges on August 31 in a ceremony witnessed by Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul, with Director-General Phichit Hunsiri signing alongside the CMC Joint Venture and Malaysia’s CHEC Construction (M) Sdn Bhd. title_cn: 兰岛大桥定于11月14日开工建设
summary_cn: 耗资17.8亿铢的兰岛 Koh Lanta 大桥工程将于11月14日开工，连接甲米 Krabi 的兰岛与泰国mainland。大桥总长2.24公里，预计3年完成，2029年竣工通车。完成后将减少岛民对渡轮的依赖——目前往来需先经由兰岛诺伊 Koh Lanta Noi 渡轮，再过西瑞兰塔桥 Siri Lanta Bridge，高峰期排队等候可达2至3小时。
desc_original: Koh Lanta bridge in Krabi set to start construction on November 14 Legacy Construction of a 1.78-billion-baht bridge linking Koh Lanta in Krabi with the mainland is due to start on Saturday, November 14, when the Department of Rural Roads plans to issue the order for work to begin. Construction of the 2.24-kilometre Koh Lanta bridge should take about three years, and the bridge is due to open in 2029, reducing the island’s reliance on the vehicle ferry. Deputy Transport Minister Sanpetch Boonyamanee, who oversees the ministry’s work in the South, gave the start date while setting out the ministry’s investment plans for the region, adding that a larger bridge over Songkhla Lake will follow the same schedule. The department signed construction contracts for both bridges on August 31 in a ceremony witnessed by Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul, with Director-General Phichit Hunsiri signing alongside the CMC Joint Venture and Malaysia’s CHEC Construction (M) Sdn Bhd. To reach Koh Lanta Yai, drivers now take a vehicle ferry to Koh Lanta Noi and then cross the Siri Lanta Bridge, and the Nation reported that waits for the ferry can reach two to three hours at peak

title: Chao Phraya high tide may flood Bangkok riverside areas November 9 to 17
desc: Chao Phraya high tide may flood Bangkok riverside areas November 9 to 17 Legacy A Chao Phraya high tide could flood low-lying riverside and canal areas of Bangkok and six central provinces from tomorrow, November 9, to November 17, the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM) warned. The greatest risk falls each morning, roughly between 6am and 1.30pm local time, when the river is forecast to reach or pass its critical level. DDPM Director-General Nirat Pongsitthithavorn said the department, acting as the central disaster prevention command, issued the alert after reviewing water conditions alongside Announcement No.15/2569, which the Royal Thai Navy’s Hydrographic Department published on November 5. The navy forecast two sets of tides, with all levels given in metres above mean sea level. Near Royal Thai Navy Headquarters in Bangkok, water is expected to reach 1.70 to 2 metres between 7.30am and 1.30pm from November 9 to 16, close to the 2-metre critical mark, so water could seep through gaps in flood walls, piers and drains. title_cn: 昭披耶河 Chao Phraya 高潮可能导致曼谷河畔11月9至17日积水
summary_cn: 灾害防治与减灾部门（DDPM）警告，昭披耶河 Chao Phraya 高潮可能从11月9日至17日导致曼谷及中部六个府的低洼河畔和运河区域积水。高危时段为每日上午6时至下午1点半左右，河水预计达到或超过临界水位。在皇家泰国海军总部附近，水位预计在11月9至16日间上升至1.70至2米，接近2米临界线，可能导致洪水从防洪墙、码头和排水口缝隙渗入。
